note: Literature confirms de novo loss-of-function variants in TAF4 reported by Bertoli-Avella et al. (2021) (2 probands) and Janssen et al. (2022) causing autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 73.

evidence.text: PanelApp notes that Bertoli-Avella et al. (2021) identified two de novo loss-of-function variants (splicing and nonsense) in two unrelated patients with intellectual disability / neurodevelopmental disorder.
